Home Cooking.name: Home Cooking
Home Cooking.description: You enjoy the fruits of your crewmate's culinary experiments. (requires Stardancer Home Cooking special ability)

Weird.name: Weird
Weird.description: You perform strange experiments, explore the Way, commune with Ur artifacts, and so on.

Pleasure.name: Pleasure
Pleasure.description: You seek hedonistic gratification from lovers, food, drink, drugs, art, etc.

Luxury.name: Luxury
Luxury.description: You seek the high life with expensive, ostentatious displays of wealth.

Stupor.name: Stupor
Stupor.description: You dull the senses with drug abuse, excessive drinking, fighting to exhaustion, etc.

Gambling.name: Gambling
Gambling.description: You crave games of chance, bet on sporting events, etc.

Obligation.name: Obligation
Obligation.description: You're devoted to a family, cause, organization, charity, etc.

Faith.name: Faith
Faith.description: You're part of a Cult or observe specific ceremonies at regular intervals.
